WITH aug AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(qty) AS aug_qty,
    SUM(revenue_cad) AS aug_rev,
    SUM(revenue_cad - (qty * pa.po_amount_cad / NULLIF(pa.po_qty,0))) AS aug_gm
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT period, sku, SUM(qty) AS po_qty, SUM(amount_cad) AS po_amount_cad
    FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
    WHERE period = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY period, sku
  ) pa ON sl.sku = pa.sku AND sl.period = pa.period
  WHERE sl.period = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
sep AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(qty) AS sep_qty,
    SUM(revenue_cad) AS sep_rev,
    SUM(revenue_cad - (qty * pa.po_amount_cad / NULLIF(pa.po_qty,0))) AS sep_gm
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT period, sku, SUM(qty) AS po_qty, SUM(amount_cad) AS po_amount_cad
    FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
    WHERE period = '2026-09'
    GROUP BY period, sku
  ) pa ON sl.sku = pa.sku AND sl.period = pa.period
  WHERE sl.period = '2026-09'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
  a.customer_id,
  a.aug_qty,
  a.aug_gm,
  s.sep_qty,
  s.sep_gm,
  (a.aug_gm / NULLIF(a.aug_qty,0)) AS aug_unit_margin,
  (s.sep_gm / NULLIF(s.sep_qty,0)) AS sep_unit_margin
FROM aug a
JOIN sep s USING (customer_id)
ORDER BY a.customer_id
